# Ticket T01

The queue consumer forwards the idle connections so later stages see a consistent view.
The config loader defers the session table and reports the outcome to the journal.
The queue consumer throttles the idle connections unless an operator pins the revision.
The audit trail records the overflow buffer and keeps the previous copy for audit.
The ingest service forwards the outbound events and reports the outcome to the journal.
A rolling restart compacts the session table once the backlog drops below the soft limit.
A rolling restart throttles its local snapshot before the next window opens.
The audit trail defers the pending batches and reports the outcome to the journal.
The scheduler rebuilds the idle connections once the backlog drops below the soft limit.

## Action

Set `s04.timeout_ms` to `4500` in config/app.conf.
